# 4 Ezra Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** 5th Ezra (Christian addition)

---

**1:1** The-word of-the-LORD came-to Ezra son-of Saraias, son-of Azarias, son-of Helkias, son-of Salemas, son-of Sadoc, son-of Achitob,

**1:2** son-of Achias, son-of Phinees, son-of Heli, son-of Amarias, son-of Aziei, son-of Marimoth, son-of Arna, son-of Ozias, son-of Borith, son-of Abisei, son-of Phinees, son-of Eleazar,

**1:3** son-of Aaron, of-the tribe of-Levi, who was-captive in-the land of-the Medes in-the reign of-Artaxerxes king of-the Persians.

**1:4** And the-word of-the-LORD came-to me, saying:

**1:5** Go, declare to my people their evil-deeds, and to their children the iniquities which they have-committed against me, so-that they may-tell their children's children,

**1:6** because the sins of-their fathers have multiplied in-them, for they have-forgotten me and have-sacrificed to strange gods.

**1:7** Was-it-not I who brought-them out of-the land of-Egypt, from the house of bondage? Yet they have-provoked me to-anger and despised my counsels.

**1:8** Pull out now the hairs of your head and hurl all evils upon them, for they have-not obeyed my law — they are a rebellious people.

**1:9** How-long shall I endure them upon-whom I have-bestowed such-great [benefits]? For-their-sake I have-overthrown many kings; I struck down Pharaoh with his servants and all his army.

**1:10** All nations I destroyed before their face; in-the East I scattered the peoples of two provinces, Tyre and Sidon, and slew all their enemies.

**1:11** Speak to them therefore, saying: Thus says the-LORD:

**1:12** Surely I led-you through the-sea and in-the beginning made for-you broad roads; I gave-you Moses as leader and Aaron as priest.

**1:13** I provided-light for-you with a pillar of fire, and I performed great wonders among-you. Yet you have-forgotten me, says the-LORD.

**1:14** Thus says the-LORD Almighty: The quails were a sign for-you; I gave-you camps as protection, yet you murmured there.

**1:15** And you did-not triumph in my name over the destruction of your enemies; but to this day you still murmur.

**1:16** Where are-the mercies I showed-you? When you were hungry and thirsty in-the wilderness, did-you-not cry out to me,

**1:17** saying: Why have-you led-us into this wilderness to kill-us? It-were better for-us to have-served the Egyptians than to die in-this desert.

**1:18** I was-grieved by your groaning and gave-you manna for food; you ate the bread of-angels.

**1:19** When you were thirsty, did I not split-open the rock and water-flowed abundantly? Because of-the heat I covered-you with leaves of-the forest.

**1:20** I divided for-you fertile lands; the Canaanites, the Perizzites, and the Philistines I drove-out before-you. What more could I have-done for-you? says the-LORD.

**1:21** Thus says the-LORD Almighty: When you were in-the wilderness, at-the bitter-waters of-the river, thirsty and blaspheming my name,

**1:22** I did-not send fire upon-you for your blasphemies but cast a tree into-the water and made the stream sweet.

**1:23** What shall I do to-you, O Jacob? Judah, you would-not obey me. I will-turn to other nations and to them I will-give my name, so-that they may-keep my statutes.

**1:24** Because you have-forsaken me I also will-forsake you; when you ask mercy of-me, I will-show-no-mercy.

**1:25** When you call-upon me I will-not hear-you, for you have-defiled your hands with blood and your feet are swift to commit murder.

**1:26** You have-not forsaken me alone, but your very-selves also, says the-LORD.

**1:27** Thus says the-LORD Almighty: Have I not implored-you as a father [implores] his sons, as a mother her daughters, and a nurse her young-children,

**1:28** so-that you should-be my people and I should-be your God, and that you should-be my sons and I should-be your father?

**1:29** I gathered-you as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But now what shall I do to-you? I will-cast-you-away from my face.

**1:30** When you offer oblations to me I will-turn-away my face from-you, for I have-rejected your feast-days and new-moons and your circumcisions of-the-flesh.

**1:31** I sent to-you my servants the prophets, but you have-taken and slain them and torn their bodies in-pieces; their blood I will-require of-your hands, says the-LORD.

**1:32** Thus says the-LORD Almighty: Your house is desolate; I will-drive-you out as the wind drives straw.

**1:33** And your children shall-not-be fruitful, for they have-neglected my commandment and have-done what-is evil before me.

**1:34** I will-give your houses to a people that-is-to-come, [a people] who without having-heard me will-believe; to-whom I have-shown no signs they will-do what-I-have commanded.

**1:35** They have-not seen the prophets yet will-recall their former-state; the testimony of-the first people I will-give to these, and they shall-be for me a people, and for-their leaders an everlasting covenant.

**1:36** Their children take-delight in me and I will-show-them salvation, for they have-received the holy-spirit from me, and I will-declare to them everlasting things.

**1:37** Do-not-regard, therefore, the death of-those nations; for-since they shall-not obey my commandments, neither shall-they be entered in-the book of-life.
